I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team to put Gate 47 on the account sheet, not Dock 23. Pree first posted Dock 23 in that channel on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so both messages were already visible to them.

I wouldn't have found this in my notes: the saved fact sits on Pree's private page and didn't come up for Hollis's request. The answer came from the channel itself.

My reply referred to Pree as "she", though Pree's pronouns haven't been stated anywhere; "they" would have been right. I can't edit the posted message. I'd leave it, since a follow-up correcting it would draw more attention than the slip, but I can post one if you'd prefer.
